zone_data_ref.spec: Luca 3 Oct: gatherable farm around the Crosshaven farmer NPC
zone_data_ref.note: dressing kit for Crosshaven farm plots; not in zone data yet

files.masters: 2x PNG at <kind>/_2x/<id>.png, draw at scale 0.5 (identical placement)

anchors.tile: image bottom-centre on the cell diamond SOUTH tip (board/tile.gd): draw at cell_to_local(cell, elev) + (-w/2, 16 - h). Floor/decal tiles are 64x32, so the image IS the diamond.
anchors.side_strip: 32x26 strip per height step k (0 = just under the top): left face top-left = south_tip + (-32, -16 + 10k), right face top-left = south_tip + (0, -16 + 10k); south_tip of the LIFTED tile. Optional upgrade over painted placeholder faces.
anchors.prop: image bottom-centre on the SOUTH tip of the footprint's south-most cell (max x+y; for 2x2 = origin+(1,1)), lifted by that cell's height: draw at cell_to_local(south_cell, elev) + (0,16) + (-w/2, -h). NW origin only defines the covered cells.
anchors.y_sort: sort by the footprint south-most cell (x+y). If you use a y-sort point instead, use image bottom - 16 px (centre of the south-most cell) and break ties in favour of characters.

tilled_soil.note: farm soil as a variant of ground; furrows along +y

tilled_soil_x.note: same soil, furrows along +x (pick per plot so rows follow the crop rows)

zone_id_map.autotile_rule: same as Crosshaven dirt_road: edge_<grass sides> base piece, plus corner_<c> decals where both sides of corner c are soil but the diagonal is not
zone_id_map.note: placer picks variants per cell with the Crosshaven hash picker

fence_axis.along_x: rail_fence_nwse: rail runs along +x, screen up-left to down-right
fence_axis.along_y: rail_fence_nesw: rail runs along +y, screen up-right to down-left
fence_axis.corners: corner_<n/e/s/w> = the ring corner at that compass point; end_<side> = gate/gap post with one rail toward <side>; rail_fence_post = lone post

farm_kit.pipeline: scratch/farm_kit: fk_cutall.py (white-bg matte + painted-shadow removal), fk_tiles.py, fk_props.py, fk_fx.py, fk_meta.py; mocks fk_mock.py, fk_gather.py
farm_kit.scale_ref: farmer NPC 256 px frame @2x, pivot (128,240), body ~120 px tall @2x; crops 40-84 px tall (below his waist), shed ridge ~220 px
farm_kit.reused_from_rowanvale: schema only; tilled_rows and fence_orchard not reused (target wants darker loamy furrows and a weathered split-rail fence with a road gap)

nameplate_blank.stretch: horizontal only (fixed height); the wood grain runs along x so the centre band stretches cleanly
